Location: Hull, UK

A Manufacturing company is recruiting for the role of a BOM Administrator who will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of an accurate bill of materials for manufacturing and after-sales within project and production timescales.

- Support the D&D Technical Support Team with information and support with direct communication with customers and dealers when requested.
- Compliance with Health & Safety requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- 5 GCSE or equivalent in English & Math and a high standard of further education (ONC or HNC level preferable)
- Additional qualifications or evidence of training in Data Management would be an advantage
- Familiar with BOM & database tools techniques
- Familiar with Microsoft Office programmes (Excel, Word etc)
- Ability to work under minimum supervision
- Strong problem solving & decision-making skills
- Ability to work well under pressure to achieve deadlines
- High level of accuracy in work and strong attention to detail
- Flexible, adaptable, enthusiastic and motivated
- Excellent verbal & written communication skills

- Keep internal systems updated with accurate movement information and shipment status details
- Make sure vehicle and load activity is prepared in advance to avoid issues at site access points
- Check all operational paperwork is in place and chase anything outstanding before movement takes place
- Work closely with other teams to keep cargo flowing efficiently through the network
- Monitor shipment progress and help resolve issues that could affect service or timing

- Strong organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail

- Be part of a team committed to rehabilitation, recovery and reducing reoffending.

As our Practice continues to grow and develop, we are looking for someone to join our Medical Administrative Team who is flexible and adaptable to the needs of the service. This is a varied and rewarding front-line role, combining medical administration and reception responsibilities. You will play an important part in supporting our patients, clinicians and wider multidisciplinary team, helping to ensure the smooth and effective day-to-day running of the Practice. If you enjoy working in a busy environment, take pride in providing excellent customer service and are looking for a role where you can make a real difference to patients, we would love to hear from you. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: Providing a friendly, professional and helpful first point of contact for patients, both face-to-face and by telephone. Handling telephone calls, digital contacts, practice emails and patient enquiries appropriately and efficiently. Undertaking medical administration and supporting the administrative elements of clinical triage. Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times. Contributing to the smooth and efficient running of the Practice. The role can be busy and fast-paced, and you will need to remain calm, professional and helpful when working under pressure. You will be expected to treat patients, visitors and colleagues with courtesy and respect and contribute to a welcoming and positive Practice environment. Candidates must therefore be able to work the required Friday late finish as part of their working pattern. We are looking for someone who is: Reliable, organised, and able to work effectively in a busy environment. Confident communicating with patients, colleagues and external organisations. Flexible and adaptable to the changing needs of a busy GP Practice. Able to manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. Professional, approachable and committed to delivering excellent patient service. Comfortable working across both administrative and reception functions. Able to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Confident using computer systems and willing to learn new systems and processes. Able to use their own initiative while also recognising when to seek advice or support. Committed to maintaining confidentiality and high standards of information governance. Able to demonstrate our values of Compassion, Respect, Learning, Quality and Integrity in their everyday work.
